condition_other: neonatal hypoxic-ischemic brain damage modelled by 6-OHDA neurotoxicity in SH-SY5Y cells
readout_other: MTT cell viability assay; Western blot of BDNF, GDNF, TH, caspase 3 and MMP-9
direction_notes: LIPUS (0.3 W/cm2, three 5 min sessions) increased SH-SY5Y viability and GDNF, and restored BDNF, GDNF and TH reduced by 6-OHDA; caspase 3 and MMP-9 rises were not reversed.
safety_notes: A single 5 min sonication at 0.1-0.5 W/cm2 did not change cell viability.

exposures.label: LIPUS on SH-SY5Y cells with or without 6-OHDA

device.model: ME740 generator with ME7410 1-MHz plane transducer

timing.protocol_description: LIPUS with a burst length of 5 ms at 50% duty cycle and 100 Hz repetition; either a single 5 min sonication or three 5 min episodes spaced 5 min apart; cells collected 24 h later.

flags.reason: Paper says 'burst length of 5 ms'; with 50% duty cycle and 100 Hz PRF the burst is the short pulse (resolved by arithmetic).

Paper reports only 'spatial average intensity' (0.1, 0.3, 0.5 W/cm2) measured by radiation force balance in degassed water; not labelled ISPPA or ISPTA, so recorded as unspecified. 0.3 W/cm2 used for the 6-OHDA experiments.
Three 5 min sonications spaced 5 min apart (a single 5 min episode was also tested); recorded 300 s per episode.
Group sizes vary by figure (n = 4 to 8 per group); no total given.
6-OHDA exposure of SH-SY5Y cells used as a cell model for neonatal hypoxic-ischemic brain damage.
Sham controls are mentioned but how they were produced is not described.
